messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
To **log in to My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, go to the MSCA sign-in page and use the sign-in method you registered with: **GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner** (your bank), or an available **provincial sign-in** option.[4][3]

- If you already registered with **GCKey**, choose that option and enter your GCKey username and password.[4][1]
- If you registered with a **bank sign-in partner**, choose **Interac® Sign-In Partner** and sign in with your online banking credentials.[4]
- If you registered with a **provincial sign-in**, use that same provincial option again; if you live outside the participating provinces, you can register with **GCKey** or a **bank** instead.[3][4]

If you do not remember your login details, MSCA offers recovery options like **forgot username** or **forgot password** for GCKey sign-ins.[1] If you are registering or validating your identity, Service Canada may ask for details such as your **SIN**, **date of birth**, **province/territory**, and sometimes an **access code** or **PAC**.[5][6]

If you want, I can give you the **exact step-by-step sign-in path** for GCKey, bank sign-in, or provincial sign-in.
